name: What steps are involved in professional drywall taping and mudding?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in professional drywall taping and mudding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall finishing starts with taping all joints and inside corners using joint compound. Once the tape coat dries, a wider fill coat is applied to conceal tape edges and screw heads. After drying, a thin finish coat feathers the edges smooth. The crew sands the dried compound with fine-grit abrasive screens, checks surfaces with work lights to catch imperfections, and wipes down dust so the drywall is ready for primer and interior paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes taping joints, applying and feathering multiple compound coats, allowing full cure time between coats, detail sanding, and dust cleanup.
